metadata.name: current public status toward unconditional full-subextremal Kerr stability
metadata.status: status report only; not a proof protocol
metadata.warning: This package records current candidate inputs and blockers. It is not a proof certificate.

proof_blocks.name: linear_to_nonlinear_estimates
proof_blocks.reference: Haefner-Hintz-Vasy 2025 full-subextremal linear stability; Ma-Szeftel 2026 perturbed-background Teukolsky Morawetz candidate
coverage: full-subextremal linear Kerr stability on exact Kerr
candidate robust Teukolsky energy-Morawetz estimates on perturbed Kerr backgrounds
remaining_obstructions: convert the linear estimates into the exact sourced nonlinear bootstrap norm used here
align derivative losses, frequency cutoffs, and gauge normalization with the metric-level argument

proof_blocks.name: trapped_superradiant_morawetz
proof_blocks.reference: Ma-Szeftel 2026 Teukolsky Morawetz estimates plus the Carter transport certificate route in this repository
coverage: major candidate route for full-subextremal Teukolsky Morawetz control
repository scaffolds radial Carter charts, SOS identities, and interval margin checks

spin-half Carter atlas now has radial coverage, degenerate seed bridges, angular corridors, ordinary overlap strips, patch coverage, parameter-thickened seed tubes, local generic angular-overlap doorway certificates, and seed-level dependent angular overlap-policy certificates
remaining_obstructions: produce actual Kerr SOS/transport cone coefficients
prove Carter-Wick quantization with losses dominated by certified margins
extend the seed-level spin-half angular overlap policies into a complete angular-torus atlas
extend the Schwarzschild blow-up interval seed to a complete small-spin trapped-set cover with overlaps to the nonzero-spin atlas
match the resulting estimate to the nonlinear metric variables

proof_blocks.name: curvature_to_metric_reconstruction
proof_blocks.reference: No compatible full-subextremal reconstruction package recorded in this repository
remaining_obstructions: reconstruct metric perturbations from Teukolsky curvature variables without fatal derivative loss
control gauge modes and linearized Kerr modes in the same global normalization
verify compatibility with constraints and final-state identification

proof_blocks.name: global_gauge_modulation
proof_blocks.reference: Giorgi-Klainerman-Szeftel 2022 slowly rotating nonlinear Kerr stability architecture
coverage: a successful nonlinear gauge/modulation model in the slowly rotating regime
remaining_obstructions: extend the architecture to each fixed full-subextremal spin
combine it with full-subextremal Teukolsky/Morawetz estimates
track final mass and angular momentum in a unified exterior foliation

proof_blocks.name: nonlinear_weak_null_hierarchy
proof_blocks.reference: Slow-rotation nonlinear Kerr proofs as a structural model
coverage: known weak-null and weighted energy closure mechanisms in nearby regimes
remaining_obstructions: produce a full-subextremal null-frame coefficient table in the chosen gauge
prove weighted source estimates with constants compatible with trapping and superradiance
budget top-order derivatives across all commuted equations

proof_blocks.name: near_extremal_parameter_control
proof_blocks.reference: No uniform-to-extremality theorem is claimed; fixed-spin constants remain allowed
coverage: the target theorem may allow constants depending on the fixed spin distance to extremality
remaining_obstructions: state and prove all constants for each fixed |a|<M without accidentally claiming extremal uniformity
separate fixed-subextremal estimates from any future uniform near-extremal theorem

proof_blocks.name: compatibility_assembly
remaining_obstructions: put all proof inputs in one gauge, foliation, Sobolev hierarchy, frequency decomposition, and symbol class
prove all remainders absorb into certified positive margins
verify the total derivative loss is below the available derivative buffer
